padre.aspetto: a grotesque man in his fifties who has changed into something like a dead tree, sitting at a kitchen table: grey-brown skin, dry and cracked all over into small plates like old bark, eyes covered by a milky white film, a half-open dry grey mouth, very long, thin, knotted fingers like dark roots pushed into the wooden table; in a stiff, dusty denim jacket over a grey t-shirt

parti.occhi: His eyes are covered by a milky white film, without pupils; the eyelids do not blink; the skin around them is grey-brown and cracked into small plates like bark.
parti.bocca: His mouth hangs half open, dry and grey, the lips cracked like dry clay; inside, the tongue is grey and stiff like a piece of wood.
parti.collo: His neck is grey-brown and cracked into small plates like the bark of an old tree; the plague buboes under the jaw have dried and hardened into dark knots, like knots in wood.

mani.inquadratura: his hands on the flowered tablecloth of the kitchen table
mani.segni: His fingers have grown very long, thin and knotted like dark roots; they have pushed through the flowered tablecloth into the wood of the table, and thin cracks spread from them across the table; the nails are black.

figlia.aspetto: a grotesque but almost photographic young woman in her early twenties, gaunt and sick, with long dark hair, in a purple hoodie with a grey wool blanket around her shoulders

parti.occhi_grave: Her eyes are sunken and glassy with very high fever, the whites red, deep dark circles under them; the skin around them is grey and shiny with sweat.

collo_grave.inquadratura: the left side of her neck under the ear, the hood and the blanket pulled aside
collo_grave.segni: Under her left ear the swelling has grown into a large dark purple bubo the size of an egg, open in the middle with a small crusted sore; the skin around it is hot and shiny.

parti.mani_grave: Her thin hands tremble; the tips of two fingers of the right hand are turning black, as if burnt; the nails are bitten to the quick.
